20:99.text: some information of what happened before. And indeed We have given you from Us a Reminder

20:100.text: (this Qur’ân - i.e. does not believe in it, nor acts on its orders)
, verily, they will bear a heavy burden

20:101.text: - and evil indeed will it be that load for them on the Day of Resurrection;

20:102.text: The Day when the Trumpet will be blown
: that Day, We shall gather the Mujrimûn
(criminals, polytheists, sinners, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh)

20:103.text: They will speak in a very low voice to each other

20:104.text: We know very well what they will say, when the best among them in knowledge and wisdom will say: "You stayed no longer than a day!"

20:105.text: And they ask you concerning the mountains: say, "My Lord will blast them and scatter them as particles of dust.

20:106.text: "Then He shall leave them as a level smooth plain.

20:107.text: "You will see therein nothing crooked or curved."

20:108.text: On that Day mankind will follow strictly
(that is without going to the right or left of that voice)
. And all voices will be humbled for the Most Gracious
, and nothing shall you hear but the low voice of their footsteps.

20:109.text: On that day no intercession shall avail, except the one for whom the Most Gracious
has given permission and whose word is acceptable to Him.

20:110.text: in this world, and what will happen to them
but they will never compass anything of His Knowledge.

20:111.text: (the Ever Living, the One Who sustains and protects all that exists)
(i.e. he who disbelieved in Allâh, ascribed partners to Him, and did deeds of His disobedience)
, will be indeed a complete failure

20:112.text: And he who works deeds of righteousness, while he is a believer
, then he will have no fear of injustice, nor of any curtailment

20:113.text: And thus We have sent it down as a Qur’ân in Arabic, and have explained therein in detail the warnings, in order that they may fear Allâh, or that it may cause them to have a lesson from it
(or to have the honour for believing and acting on its teachings)
